description: This trail follows an old road until it descends to the Koksilah River. It is used by horseback riders, bikers and hikers.
directions: From Highway #1 turn onto Cobble Hill Road and then onto Thain Road. Turn right onto Kingburne Drive and follow until the pavement ends. The trail begins on the right hand side ~300m passed the end of the pavement.
title: Skrimshire Trail
